summary: Agent asked for a PIN (sensitive secret) and performed incomplete identity verification steps.

findings.quote: Do you have your pin number
findings.explanation: The agent asks the customer for a PIN. Policy explicitly forbids asking for passwords, PINs, one-time codes or CVV; this is a major violation (asks for a secret the task does not need).

findings.quote: I need your email address. I will send the rest code to your email address
findings.explanation: Although the system log shows the account was pulled up (turn 4), the agent did not complete the required identity verification steps for a sensitive account action (policy requires full name, account ID and order ID to verify identity). The agent requested an email address and then asked for a PIN (turn 7) instead of using the required verification fields, so verification is incomplete.
